tasks.subject: Task 1: Pure decision-tree match compiler core (Wok.IR.Match)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Standalone, unit-tested compileMatch turning a clause matrix into an ANF decision tree (Case/AltCon/AltLit/AltDefault) with Jump leaves.

**Files:** Create src/Wok/IR/Match.hs; Modify wok.cabal; Test test/Spec.hs (matchCompilerTests)

**Verify:** cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p "MatchCompiler"'

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/IR/Match.hs", "wok.cabal", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"MatchCompiler\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["single-column constructor matrix -> one Case, AltDefault only when incomplete", "two-column nested Cases with fallthrough", "literal column tests constructor once then switches literal", "var/wildcard bind atom, leaf Jumps in rowOrder"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Exhaustiveness + redundancy analysis (matchCoverage)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure matchCoverage over the same matrix reporting redundant clause indices and exhaustiveness, reusing Task 1's specialization machinery.

**Files:** Modify src/Wok/IR/Match.hs (Coverage, matchCoverage); Test test/Spec.hs (matchCoverageTests)

**Verify:** cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p "MatchCoverage"'

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/IR/Match.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"MatchCoverage\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["partial single clause non-exhaustive", "full finite signature exhaustive", "shadowed clause reported redundant", "literal columns non-exhaustive"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Widen TypedDecl to a clause list; keep all clauses in finalizeGroupTyped
tasks.description:
**Goal:** TypedDecl carries tdClauses :: [([TPat], TExpr)]; finalizeGroupTyped freezes ALL clauses under one mapping; arity-agreement check.

**Files:** Modify src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs, src/Wok/TypeChecking/Error.hs, src/Wok/IR/Elaborate.hs; Test test/Spec.hs

**Verify:** cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p "ClauseArity"'

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs", "src/Wok/TypeChecking/Error.hs", "src/Wok/IR/Elaborate.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"ClauseArity\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["TypedDecl exposes tdClauses, tdParams/tdBody removed", "single-clause is one-element list", "multi-clause keeps every clause", "arity mismatch raises ClauseArityMismatch", "existing typecheck goldens unchanged"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Elaborate function heads through the match compiler
tasks.description:
**Goal:** elabTopBind builds one fresh param binder per column, a LetJoin per clause body, a ConOracle from Env, and calls compileMatch; single-variable-only and single-clause record heads keep the cheap path.

**Files:** Modify src/Wok/IR/Elaborate.hs; Test test/typecheck-examples/11-multi-clause.wok + test/anf-golden/11-multi-clause.expected

**Verify:** cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p "11-multi-clause"'

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/IR/Elaborate.hs", "test/typecheck-examples/11-multi-clause.wok", "test/anf-golden/11-multi-clause.expected"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"11-multi-clause\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["multi-clause -> Case tree with LetJoin per clause", "leaf Jumps to correct join in variable order", "single-clause ANF byte-identical, existing goldens pass", "multi-clause record column errors clearly"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Wire exhaustiveness + redundancy warnings into type checking
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Emit NonExhaustiveMatch and RedundantClause warnings during type checking, computed by matchCoverage over typed clauses, using a ConOracle from the env.

**Files:** Modify src/Wok/TypeChecking/Error.hs, src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs; Test test/Spec.hs (matchWarningTests)

**Verify:** cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p "MatchWarnings"'

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/TypeChecking/Error.hs", "src/Wok/TypeChecking/Infer.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"MatchWarnings\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["partial single clause emits one NonExhaustiveMatch", "total function emits none", "shadowed clause emits RedundantClause with index", "warnings reach pipeline channel"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: End-to-end run goldens (zip, literal fallthrough, safe-head)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove multi-clause functions execute correctly end-to-end (parse -> typecheck -> elaborate -> interpret).

**Files:** Create test/run-examples/{11-multi-clause-zip,12-maybe-literal,13-safe-head}.wok + test/run-golden/*.expected

**Verify:** cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p "run golden"'

```json:metadata
{"files": ["test/run-examples/11-multi-clause-zip.wok", "test/run-examples/12-maybe-literal.wok", "test/run-examples/13-safe-head.wok", "test/run-golden/11-multi-clause-zip.expected", "test/run-golden/12-maybe-literal.expected", "test/run-golden/13-safe-head.expected"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test wok-tests --test-options='-p \"run golden\"'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["zip-style returns 66", "literal fallthrough returns 100 without crash", "safe-head returns 7", "all three match goldens"]}
```
